about.text: A Brazilian semi-hard cheese, similar to the Dutch Edam cheese

sources.text: Brazilian Edam-derived semi-hard cheese, paraffin-coated; pt wiki confirms semi-hard and waxed/Edam lineage but gives no ripening time

facts.v: Named after luxury European goods imported after 1808; considered the first industrially matured cheese in Brazil
